stop.details: Builds a plan on the server, shows what will be done and asks for confirmation before stopping. With the all selector, confirmation requires typing "all". With --at/--in, it creates a scheduled action instead of running now (target all is dynamic; whole projects include new instances; anything else stays fixed).

start.details: Builds a plan on the server, shows what will be done and asks for confirmation before starting. With the all selector, confirmation requires typing "all". With --at/--in, it creates a scheduled action instead of running now (target all is dynamic; whole projects include new instances; anything else stays fixed).

restart.summary: restarts instances: stops, then starts the ones that stopped
restart.details: Two operations in the history (stop, then start). Instances that were not running are not started. If the console is closed between the steps, the instances stay stopped and, when reopened, the console shows the command to start them.

at.help: not supported: a restart cannot be scheduled

in.help: not supported: a restart cannot be scheduled

status.summary: overview: indicators, alerts and the state of each instance

refresh.summary: reads the state of every instance on Railway again

op.summary: shows and follows an operation until the end

no-wait.help: shows the current state without following

history.summary: history of operation items, with the same filters as the screen

at/show.summary: shows an action and the operation it generated

schedule/list.summary: lists schedules with the next run

schedule/create.summary: creates a schedule for a project (or environment, or instances)

schedule/edit.summary: changes a schedule (only the given fields; --window replaces all)

env.help: target: whole project restricted to one environment

schedule/pause.summary: pauses (events during the pause are not recovered)

project/discover.summary: lists the projects reachable by the token on Railway

project/import.summary: imports projects from Railway (name or ID) or all unmanaged ones

all.help: imports every accessible project not yet managed

project/add.summary: registers a project by its Railway ID

project/show.summary: details, instances and schedules of a project

project/edit.summary: changes display name and description (empty clears)

name.help: display name ("" goes back to the Railway name)

project/sync.summary: syncs name, environments and states with Railway

project/rm.summary: removes the project from management (nothing changes on Railway)

instance/discover.summary: lists the project's instances on Railway and whether they are managed

all.help: imports every unmanaged one (except ephemeral environments)

instance/rm.summary: removes instances from management (nothing changes on Railway)

service/rm.summary: removes the service and all its instances from management

credential/set.summary: registers or replaces the token (typed in a masked field)
credential/set.details: The token is never accepted as an argument and never goes into the command history.

help.summary: lists the commands or shows the help of a command

open.summary: opens a screen of the interface or a project page (in CLI mode, switches to the graphical interface)

alias.summary: creates or lists aliases (stored in this browser)

login.summary: logs in with username and password (the password is typed in a masked field)
login.details: In CLI mode this is the first command: before logging in, only login, ui, cli, help, clear and language work.

ui.summary: switches to the graphical interface (the session stays the same)

cli.summary: switches to command-line-only mode (the session stays the same)

language.summary: shows or changes the interface language (stored in this browser)

args.idioma: pt-BR or en; with no argument, shows the current language

env.help: restricts every selector to one environment

dry-run.help: only shows the plan; nothing is executed

no-wait.help: does not follow the operation; shows only the identifier

at.help: schedules for an instant: HH:MM, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, DD/MM HH:MM, "tomorrow HH:MM"

in.help: schedules for a duration from now: 30m, 2h, 1h30m

result.help: pending, running, verifying, succeeded, failed, skipped, timed_out, interrupted

status.help: pending, processing, executed, late, skipped, missed, failed, cancelled

window.help: on window (start turns on, end turns off); end < start crosses midnight

instances.help: service@environment separated by commas (instead of the whole project)

arg.seletor: all, project, project@environment, project/service, project/service@environment; accepts * and IDs
arg.destino: overview, visao, inicio, projects, projetos, schedules, agendas, history, historico, settings, config, console or project name

globalOpt.json: shows the API response as JSON, unformatted
